name: Nonprofit Forms
author: Sila Santosh Kumar

sections.description:
Nonprofit Forms is a lean form builder made for Indian nonprofits and anyone who wants forms without extra weight.

  • Build a form with text, email, phone, number, date, long text, dropdown, single choice, multiple choice and consent fields.
  • Spam protection that runs on your own server: hidden field, signed timer, rate limit and link check. No reCAPTCHA, no Google or Cloudflare scripts.
  • Email notification with a Reply-To set to the person who wrote to you.
  • Entries saved in WordPress, with a viewer and CSV download that opens correctly in Excel (Hindi and other Indian scripts included).
  • Add a form with a shortcode or the “Nonprofit Form” block.
  • Style it in the block editor, no CSS needed: label, field and border colours, corner roundness, filled or outline submit button, plus the standard colour, font size, spacing and border controls. A contrast check warns when text would be hard to read.
  • Works without JavaScript on the public page.
  • Privacy friendly by default: no cookies, no IP address stored, automatic deletion of old entries, and support for WordPress personal data export and erase. Built with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act in mind. This plugin helps; it is not legal advice.
  • Developers can add field types and hook into the submission (see below).

Shortcode

[nonprofit_form id="123"]

For developers

  • Filter npfrm_field_types to add field types.
  • Filter npfrm_spam_reason, npfrm_max_links, npfrm_rate_limit to tune spam checks.
  • Filter npfrm_notification to change the email. Action npfrm_submitted runs after a clean submission.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Nonprofit Forms > Add new, build your form and publish.
  3. Paste the shortcode into a page, or add the Nonprofit Form block.
sections.faq:
Does it use reCAPTCHA?

No. Nothing is loaded from outside your site.

Where are entries kept?

In your WordPress database. Set how long under Nonprofit Forms > Settings.

Does it support file uploads or payments?

Not yet. A donations plugin is planned separately.
sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • New: private analytics (views, submissions, per day, no cookies or IPs).
  • New: choose who can see a form, and which roles can read its entries.
  • New: plain-language privacy notice that records the wording each person saw; guardian consent block for under-18s.
  • New: conditional fields, conditional email routing, auto-reply, open/close dates and entry limits.
  • New: entry search, status and private notes, bulk delete, erase a person’s data.
  • New: Indian mobile, PIN code and State/UT fields.
  • New: stronger spam armor: adjustable rate limit, temporary-email blocking and a blocked-words list.

0.1.0

  • First release.
